The '''TC-40 Padlink''' was a device manufactured by [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]]. It enabled users to hook into a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] terminal and allow them access the system from a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. The comm attachment was installed into the master terminal, while a mobile unit connected to the datapad through the device's minor coupler ports. Popular with executives, it allowed them work without being forced to sit in front of a computer all day long.

The TC-40 was used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] into restricted files. However, the Padlink device had to be previously installed on the master system beforehand. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] used the TC-40 during an operation on [[Arsteni]] to download troop reports without entering the building.
